gaps.sentence: You go ahead; I'll catch ___ with you later.
gaps.explanation: catch up (with) = reach the same point/level as somebody.

gaps.sentence: Prices levelled ___ after the crazy spring market.
gaps.explanation: level off = stop rising or falling and stay the same.

gaps.sentence: The new stadium made ___ an impressive sight.
gaps.explanation: make for = produce a particular result (make for a good atmosphere); also move towards.
bring down = cause a government/person to lose power; reduce (prices).

gaps.sentence: Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.

gaps.sentence: The new manager wants to back ___ the sales team's proposal.
gaps.explanation: back up = support (a person, plan); also make a copy of data.
pick up = learn without formal study; also collect (pick somebody up).

gaps.sentence: Hold ___ a moment — I'll check if he's in.
gaps.explanation: hold on = wait (especially on the phone).
